basic_info.description: Reduced $500k! Nestled in the heart of Presidio Heights, 316-318 Laurel St is an exquisitely renovated two unit building that seamlessly blends charm and luxury. Originally built in 1905 and extensively renovated in 2024, this sophisticated residence offers a total of 5,085 sqft (per architect) of elegant living space across two separate units. The front residence (316 Laurel) boasts 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, featuring a spacious primary suite with a serene sitting area and a spa-like bath with a soaking tub. Expansive windows flood the home with natural light, while two private terraces provide a peaceful retreat. The rear residence (318 Laurel) offers 1 bedroom + den and 1.5 bathrooms, a chef's kitchen with a Wolf oven and gas cooktop, and a generous great room that opens to a private, landscaped patio. A bonus lower-level media room provides extra entertaining space. Luxury abounds throughout, with European white oak flooring, radiant in-floor heating, and custom Velux skylights. The gated driveway provides parking for 2 cars and includes an EV outlet. Ideally located just off Sacramento Street, this home is moments from world-class dining, boutique shopping, The Presidio, and the Golden Gate Bridge.
